target_customer: Outpatient clinics, physician offices and private practices
problem: Clinic front desks are swamped by calls, intake, insurance checks and no-shows, and clinicians lack pre-visit summaries.
business_model: B2B SaaS for AI voice agents (pricing not found)
product_category: Healthcare AI voice agents and patient intake

founders.name: Pablo Bermudez-Canete
founders.background_notes: Stanford student, left to work on the company full time per Stanford Daily.

founders.name: Tannen Hall
founders.background_notes: Cites family experience with an undiagnosed rare disease as motivation.

competitors.name: Hyro
competitors.what: Healthcare voice and chat AI agents for health systems handling scheduling, registration and routing

technical_complexity.rationale: Voice agents with EHR integration and clinical triage protocols, built on third party speech and language models; the hard parts are integration and safety.

defensibility.rationale: EHR integrations and clinic workflow lock-in help, but many funded voice agent vendors target the same buyers.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Still operating; later 2025 and 2026 reports show many rivals raising large rounds.

market_need_then: Clinic phone and intake burden is widespread, and 2024 to 2025 funding for healthcare voice AI indicates demand; no company usage figures verified.

branding.name_origin: Paratus is Latin for ready or prepared, but no source states that the founders chose it for that reason.

identity.voice_and_tone: Clinical credibility: references Schmitt-Thompson protocols and go live in three weeks

brand_strength.rationale: Local press from the Stanford Daily, but no brand specific community or press evidence; name similar to Paratus Medical and others.

pivots.from: Conversational patient intake with pre-visit clinical summary
pivots.to: AI operations layer for clinics (front desk calls, billing prep, documentation)
pivots.why: Not stated; positioning differs between YC page and company site

outcome_analysis: Paratus Health is an active YC W25 company that moved from pre-visit intake toward a broader voice agent operations layer for outpatient clinics. It reports pilots and a seed round, but amounts conflict across sources, and it faces many well funded voice AI rivals. There is no exit or failure to explain yet.
notes: Seed amount conflicts: company about page says $3M, aggregators say $2.3M (March 2025), $3.5M total, and $500K; all unverified or conflicting so no round recorded. Investors named by aggregators: Y Combinator, GGoAhead Ventures, Lobster Capital. Assort Health and Hippocratic AI are named as rivals in 2025 and 2026 sources, which postdate founding, so not listed.
